messages:
Rae: quick thought — can the rollout console include a tiny 'playback' preview for autofallbacks? run the rule against last 5m and show "would have" counts.
Tom: love that. super helpful for confidence. keep it lightweight: total matched, pct traffic, sample 3 redacted requests.
Lina: add a compact compatibility check too: api-compat, token-fit, quota-warning. if something fails, show a short help link.
Jon: audit needs: playback_snapshot_id, policy_id, triggered_count, operator. playback should be stored as a readonly snapshot and linked in the audit.
Rae: UX: playback button in composer opens a small modal with 3 panels: summary, samples, timeline. include an "enable" CTA if preview looks ok.
Tom: also have the playback simulate soft-sample rates so operators can see expected QPS on fallback. show an estimated cost delta.
fallback-bot: playback snapshot created pb-2100601234-1 by Rae. audit://pb-2100601234-1
Lina: security: default redact=true and require "view raw" 2FA for sensitive routes. log who views unredacted.
Jon: small backend note: store normalized AST for triggers so playback and live evaluator use same logic.
Rae: i'll throw a 10s mock in figma and post for review. can @Lina and @Tom check later today?
Tom: will review at 3pm PST.
Lina: yep, will join the review.
